meta.title: Ondra Minecraft Access
meta.description: A capability entry point for Minecraft, shipped as a skeleton. The Mineflayer layer belongs behind a driver port; this package provides the speech gate, the text shaping and the link state machine. Three checks were run before starting, and all three came back empty: the handbook never mentions minecraft or Mineflayer, nothing under desktop packages exposes a reusable service key, and this repository forbids installing dependencies. So no guessed connection code is written here, because its failure mode is connected but receiving nothing, which looks exactly like not connected at all. The gate covers the three riskiest points once a connection exists, and none of them lives in the protocol layer: chat over 256 characters makes the server drop the connection outright rather than returning an error, command arguments can carry selectors such as kill-at-all, and flooding gets the account banned irreversibly. The command allow-list ships empty, so no command is permitted at all. There is no automatic reconnect, because an account repeatedly appearing and disappearing on someone else's server is the easiest way to be flagged, and what was missed during the reconnect window is unknowable. Text is truncated by UTF-16 code units without splitting a surrogate pair. Disabled by default, with status reading as the only capability enabled out of the box.
